resources.string: Build a four-corner mesh with MeshGradientPainter, normalized positions and selectable color palettes.
Move the center of a nine-vertex mesh, edit Bézier tangents and compare bilinear with bicubic colors.
Animate a sixteen-vertex mesh with drawing-phase state reads, movement controls, pause, resume and reset.
Add mesh vertices by inserting rows and columns, drag points and edit each vertex color with swatches and RGB sliders.
Edit vertex positions and colors in two matching meshes, then animate between the start and end frames with pause and resume.
